parties.counterparty: Manufacturers' Services Western U.S. Operations, Inc. (MSL)

plans.note: Primary clause is Base Agreement 15.3 Limitations of Liability (p0272-p0273: mutual waiver of lost profits/consequential/punitive/incidental). Check whether a monetary aggregate cap exists in the remaining 15.3 paragraph and whether carve-outs (indemnity, confidentiality, IP) are preserved. The one-sided limitation in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement 15 (p1574-p1575) caps MSL's remedies against IBM and favours us; p0174 asset-sale disclaimer is context only.

MSL indemnity in 15.1 (p0259 defend/hold harmless/indemnify; p0260 IP and MSL-procured parts; p0263 carve-backs) plus 15.2 payment/cooperation conditions (p0266 notice, p0271 remedy options). Additional MS/IBM indemnity at p1359 and audit-cost indemnity at p1448. Confirm coverage of third-party IP and MSL misconduct, that p0263 exclusions are limited to IBM-caused claims/IBM-specified designs, and read 16.21 (p0334) for the infringement-suspension interaction.

No restriction on the businesses IBM may operate or the products it may buy or build was located. Tangential hits only: p0116 (termination right if a Party is acquired by a direct competitor) and p1491 (confidentiality agreement preserving freedom to compete/supply competitors), both neutral or favourable. Skim the Product Attachments before recording absence.

Searches for exclusive, sole/primary supplier, requirements-from and second-source returned no clause obliging IBM to source exclusively from MSL; the only 'exclusive' hits are an entire-agreement clause (p1500) and MSL's exclusive remedy in the loan agreement (p1574). Skim SOW 6.0 Purchase of Products and the 3.0/4.0 responsibility lists to confirm purchase obligations are order-driven.

Only MFN found runs in our favour: p1099 requires MSL engineering to be priced to IBM on a most favored customer basis. Direction rule - do not flag. Confirm no reciprocal obligation on IBM in the SOW pricing sections.

p0189 binds IBM: for [*] years from the Effective Date IBM will not solicit Transferred Employees for employment without MSL's prior written consent. Assess duration, absence of a general-advertising/unsolicited-applicant carve-out, and whether it is limited to Transferred Employees; read surrounding 9.0 personnel provisions for context.

No convenience-termination right for IBM was found in the Base Agreement: 5.1 appears breach/insolvency/competitor-acquisition based (p0110, p0116) - paginate all 14 paragraphs of 5.1 to confirm. Supporting hits: p0722 (IBM may cancel Purchase Orders for convenience subject to cancellation charges), p1497 (either party may terminate the Confidential Information agreement on [*] months' notice), and the loan agreement term/termination section. Assess whether the absence of a customer convenience right is a deviation.

p0104: three-year initial term with automatic renewal language (snippet truncated - read full 4.0 for renewal period, notice window and any price uplift). SOW 2.0 (p0658) mirrors the term. Supplement/Attachment terms at p0374, p0377, p0565 have fixed expiry with optional three-month extensions on mutually agreed terms.

16.9 (p0300) selects New York substantive law with a jury-trial waiver; p0301 requires actions within [*] years in a court sited in New York (no arbitration). p1499 applies New York law to the Confidential Information agreement. New York is accepted - expect compliant; note the jury waiver and contractual limitations period in the rationale only.

16.2 (p0281) bars either Party from assigning, transferring or subcontracting without prior consent - check for an affiliate/successor carve-out for IBM and read the remaining 16.2 paragraphs. 16.5 Sale or Merger (p0290) requires MSL notice and successor assumption (favourable); p0116 gives a termination right on competitor acquisition. p0327 and p1497 confirm binding effect on permitted successors.

Ownership runs to us: p0197 (MSL assigns all IP in hardware/tooling/processes), p0198 (IBM owns MSL inventions on Products). Licence-back to MSL limited to confidential information (p0208). Attachment 6 bars Derivative Works of IBM Software Packages (p1304); loan agreement 5 covers ownership of Loaned Items (p1529). Confirm nothing assigns IBM IP or data to MSL; 13.2 (p0202-p0204) governs our information.

Licence grants run from IBM to MSL (p0208 royalty-free licence to IBM confidential information; p1530 licence to use/store/modify Loaned Programs; p1532 execute-only Licensed Internal Code; p1346 no MSL right to MS Software Images), so the customer-side concerns (affiliates/contractors, revocability) are largely inapplicable - verify no inbound licence to IBM is required and check 12.2 Acquisition and Continued Licensing for terms binding us.

Audit rights predominantly favour us (7.0 IBM process audits at MSL sites p0163-p0164; consigned inventory audit p0909; acceptance inspection p1047; tooling inspection). Read Attachment 6 4.0 (p1309) and Appendix A 4 (p1442-p1443, cost-shifting p1448) to confirm no reciprocal audit of IBM's books, and 16.14 (p0317) mutual five-year record retention for burden on us.

Charges potentially payable by us: p0722 (cancellation charges on IBM's convenience cancellation of Purchase Orders, waived on MSL default), Premium Cost section, 5.3 prices upon termination (p0143 inventory/parts buyback pricing), p0186 (IBM reimburses termination benefits) and p1225 (IBM reimburses MVS licence charges). p0757 imposes a [*]% penalty on the Work Center's material cost - confirm it runs against MSL. Assess whether any amount is a penalty rather than cost recovery.

SOW 19 is the core warranty: p1059 express warranty on Products/materials/work, p1068 warranty period commencement, 19.2 defective FRUs (p1071), 19.4 title (p1075), 19.5 turnaround, 19.6 Implied Warranties (p1078 - check for a disclaimer adverse to us), 19.7 epidemic failure. Supplemented by MSL reps 14.2 (p0242), Attachment 6 3.0 (p1299), tooling warranty (p1094), nonconforming acceptance (p1055). p1567 is IBM's own disclaimer for Loaned Items (favourable).

No programme-level vendor insurance covenant (CGL/E&O/cyber limits, additional insured, certificates) was located. Partial coverage: p0909 requires MSL replacement-value insurance on consigned Products with IBM as joint insured; p1107 allocates tooling insurance; p1539 shifts risk of loss on Loaned Items to IBM; p0649/p0863 treat freight insurance as a cost element. Assess whether the missing insurance article is a deviation.

No take-or-pay or minimum volume commitment found; instead forecast-linked exposure: p0132-p0135 and p0143 require IBM to take/pay for MSL inventory and on-order Parts against IBM forecasts on termination, subject to Appendix 4 Supply Flexibility; p0903 states IBM has no liability for inventory MSL buys outside those parameters; p0769 references a minimum volume parameter tied to pricing. Quantify forecast-based exposure and confirm the exit path.

5.2 Rights Upon Termination is the main location (p0120 onward): p0130 requires MSL to return all IBM documentation and confidential media within [*] days; p0123 continued reporting of Parts PO cancellations; p0132-p0135 inventory/Parts transfer; p0175 IBM option to purchase MSL assets post-termination. Attachment 6 3 (p1435) requires return of MS Software Images. Test whether continued supply/transition assistance for a defined wind-down and orderly return of data and tooling are adequately covered; note 12.0 Transition Services (p0195) is start-up, not exit.
